name: worker_idle_model_eviction

test_list.description: The native owner drops its resource before acknowledgement and reports no model on a second eviction.
Observation does not renew the deadline; its inclusive expiry and a later reload are explicit.
A failed loader cannot leave a resident model or an active idle deadline.
CLI idle bounds are validated without returning rejected input values.
Load the installed model, leave the service idle beyond 45 seconds, and require a subsequent eviction request to report zero remaining models.
Reject zero, sub-millisecond, and excessive idle intervals.
Run inference, observe idle eviction, and run inference again through the authenticated child client.

inputs.name: idle_ttl
inputs.description: Finite idle interval measured after completed native work.

output_description: A bounded service whose native owner drops idle sessions and lazily reloads them. Handle destruction is not a measurement of RSS release or proof of preemptive native-work cancellation.
